```lean4
import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Basic
import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.PiL2
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FDeriv.Basic
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Log.Basic

open Real Filter ContinuousLinearMap

namespace OasisSovereign.FluidDynamics

abbrev Space3D := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)

structure SolenoidalField where
  u : Space3D → Space3D
  diff : ContDiff ℝ 1 u
  div_free : ∀ x, (∑ i : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ (fun y => u y i) x (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)) = 0

structure BesovNormB0 (v : SolenoidalField) where
  val : ℝ
  pos : 0 < val

def DyadicProjector (j : ℕ) (v : SolenoidalField) : Space3D → Space3D := sorry
def BonyCommutatorField (j : ℕ) (v : SolenoidalField) : Space3D → Space3D := sorry

theorem bony_commutator_3d_bound
    (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≥ 1)
    (v : SolenoidalField)
    (normB0 : BesovNormB0 v)
    (norm_L2 : (Space3D → Space3D) → ℝ) :
    ∃ (C : ℝ), C > 0 ∧ norm_L2 (BonyCommutatorField j v) ≤ C * (j : ℝ) * normB0.val := by
  sorry

end OasisSovereign.FluidDynamics
```

messages.content: Formula en Lean 4 el Teorema de Kozono-Taniuchi para la acotación logarítmica de ||∇u||_{L^∞} mediante la norma de Besov Ḃ⁰_{∞,∞}(ω) y la norma de Sobolev Hˢ(u) con s > 5/2.

```lean4
import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Basic
import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.PiL2
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Log.Basic

open Real Filter

namespace OasisSovereign.FluidDynamics

abbrev Space3D := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)

structure SmoothVectorField where
  fn : Space3D → Space3D
  smooth : ContDiff ℝ ⊤ fn

def curl (u : SmoothVectorField) : SmoothVectorField := sorry

structure LInftyGradNorm (u : SmoothVectorField) where
  val : ℝ
  pos : 0 ≤ val

structure BesovNormB0Infty (w : SmoothVectorField) where
  val : ℝ
  pos : 0 ≤ val

structure SobolevHsNorm (s : ℝ) (u : SmoothVectorField) where
  val : ℝ
  pos : 0 ≤ val

theorem kozono_taniuchi_logarithmic_bound
    (s : ℝ) (hs : s > 5/2)
    (u : SmoothVectorField)
    (grad_norm : LInftyGradNorm u)
    (besov_norm : BesovNormB0Infty (curl u))
    (sobolev_norm : SobolevHsNorm s u) :
    ∃ (C : ℝ), C > 0 ∧
      grad_norm.val ≤ C * (1 + besov_norm.val * Real.log (1 + sobolev_norm.val)) := by
  sorry

end OasisSovereign.FluidDynamics
```
